details.handmade: Each piece is handmade, so small variations in shape and finish are part of its character.
care.jewelry: Keep away from water, perfume and chemicals. Wipe gently with a soft cloth and store in a dry pouch.
care.leather: Keep away from water and heat. Clean with a soft dry cloth and let the leather rest between wears.
ship.summary: Made to order. Delivery times and costs are on our shipping page. You can return unworn items within 14 days.
size.ring: Wrap a thin strip of paper around the base of your finger, mark where it overlaps and measure the length in millimetres. Choose the size closest to that circumference.
size.bracelet: Measure your wrist with a soft tape and add about 1.5 to 2 cm for a comfortable fit.
size.belt: Measure the length of a belt that fits you well, from the fold at the buckle to the hole you use. Or take your waist measurement and add about 5 cm.
size.note: Between two sizes, choose the larger one. Not sure? Write to us.
